title: See what zero-hour auto purge (ZAP) removed after delivery
summary: Defender advanced hunting: phishing and malware that ZAP pulled from mailboxes after delivery, per day and result, plus the most-hit recipients.
code:
// Microsoft Defender portal > Hunting > Advanced hunting
EmailPostDeliveryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("Phish ZAP", "Malware ZAP")
| summarize Messages = dcount(NetworkMessageId), Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress)
    by Day = bin(Timestamp, 1d), ActionType, ActionResult
| order by Day desc
notes: This table covers email. ZAP for Teams messages is configured separately in the Teams protection policy (see the linked recipe).
Join on NetworkMessageId with EmailEvents to get sender and subject for a message.
